name: Statement of Financial Interests
description: Board members must file a statement of financial interests before taking office or receiving compensation; the Solicitor and designated employees must also file one as required by law.
preparedBy: Board members; District Solicitor; designated District employees
recipient: Not specified (filed as required by law)
deadline: as required by law; before taking the oath of office
quote: No Board member shall be allowed to take the oath of office or enter or continue upon their duties, nor shall they receive compensation from public funds, unless they have filed a statement of financial interests as required by law. The District Solicitor and designated District employees shall file a statement of financial interests as required by law and regulations.
